name: Maropost
description: Maropost Marketing Cloud provides campaign, contact, content, list, journey, reporting, and multichannel messaging APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect the exact customer-owned account ID and least-privilege API key. Relay pins five REST operations: one bounded campaign listing runs directly, two exact campaign/contact reads and two one-contact list writes require approval, and writes additionally require recorded contact authorization.

credentialRequirements.name: MAROPOST_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Maropost account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact customer-owned Marketing Cloud account ID; Relay derives the documented regional API origin from it.

credentialRequirements.name: MAROPOST_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Maropost API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated least-privilege customer-owned key, optionally restricted to Railway staging egress IPs.

capabilities.label: List campaigns
capabilities.description: Use one bounded page of campaign metadata.

capabilities.label: Read campaign or contact
capabilities.description: Use one exact campaign read and one email contact lookup with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage list contacts
capabilities.description: Use two single-contact list writes with approval and contact authorization attestation.

allowed.label: List Maropost campaigns
allowed.description: List one bounded page of campaign metadata from the account's documented regional API origin.

approvalRequired.label: Read Maropost campaign or contact
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact campaign or one exact contact lookup.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Maropost list contacts
approvalRequired.description: Upsert or update one authorized email contact in one exact list with explicit subscription state.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Account IDs, API keys, authorization headers, and credential-bearing response fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk or streaming APIs
blocked.description: GraphQL, streaming, Data Journeys, imports, exports, relational tables, recipient-event reports, and unbounded pagination are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Campaign/content/list creation, sending, deletion, journey control, SMS/push, suppression removal, account/key administration, and remote content URLs remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only five pinned REST routes run on account-derived documented regional origins; arbitrary URLs, methods, headers, query fields, bodies, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded campaign listing runs directly; exact campaign/contact reads and both single-contact writes require approval, and writes also require explicit recorded contact authorization.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; contact authorization, regional routing, allowlists, bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts five pinned Maropost operations and injects encrypted account credentials only into account-derived regional REST requests.

providerSetup.blocker: Maropost requires a customer-owned Marketing Cloud account, least-privilege API key, correct regional account routing, and permission-based list/contact configuration. No console, account, key, IP allowlist, contact, consent, campaign, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure a dedicated staging account ID/key in Railway staging, optionally restrict the key to staging egress IPs, and verify regional routing, campaign/contact reads, approval and contact-authorization denial/allow, explicit subscribe/unsubscribe behavior, pagination and response bounds, concurrency/rate behavior, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Maropost's April 2026 OpenAPI guide documents production regional origins, ApiKey Authorization headers, JSON, 10-call account concurrency, pagination, and the exact campaign/contact routes selected by Relay.
Maropost documents Marketing Cloud REST and GraphQL APIs, API-key authentication, and the account Connections reference surface.
Maropost documents REST campaign, contact, list, report, journey, SMS, transactional, and push categories and recommends non-REST facilities for bulk transfer.
Maropost documents dedicated API keys, one-time secret retrieval, privileges, optional IP whitelisting, and key lifecycle management.
